description: Place a paid order: a complete book, manual, technical spec or multi-volume series; an AUDIOBOOK narrated from your manuscript; a SHORT-VIDEO for TikTok/Reels/Shorts (9:16); a YOUTUBE-VIDEO (16:9); or a cast/world/sample pack. IF YOUR KEY HAS CREDIT AND YOU QUOTE IN GBP THIS SETTLES INSTANTLY WITH NO CHECKOUT PAGE (top up via inkflow_topup); a credit order also needs startNowConsent: true, your statement that the person you buy for asked us to start straight away. Otherwise returns a Stripe payment URL — writing starts automatically the moment payment clears, with per-chapter progress via inkflow_job_status and webhooks. Requires your INKFLOW apiKey: get one free with the inkflow_register tool (or POST https://api.inkflowstudio.org/api/agents/register).

attachments.description: Pictures/diagrams for the production: character refs, location photos, storyboards. Each {name, mime, url or dataBase64 (max 40MB), note}.

brief.description: Any amount of supporting text: outline, world bible, style notes, or a full manuscript to adapt. No length cap.

docControl.description: document control block printed at the front

docStyle.description: manual / SOP / revision: house style - plain English, Easy Read, or Simplified Technical English (ste)

expertReview.description: manual / SOP: add a human expert review

idempotencyKey.description: any unique string per intended order: a retry with the same key returns the first order instead of charging again

premise.description: what to write — premise, subject or spec

productModel.description: manual / technical-spec: the make and model to research, e.g. 'Bosch GSR 18V-55'

seriesPlan.description: series: your own plan - {bible, volumes:[{title, tier: novella|standard|epic, outline}]}

sourceLanguage.description: translation: the language the manuscript is in (optional; detected if absent)

sourceOrderId.description: make this FROM a book you already bought here: an audiobook of it, or a video based on it. Must be your own delivered order.

startNowConsent.description: REQUIRED when the order settles from your credit balance (there is no checkout page): true states that the person you are buying for asked Inkflow to start straight away and understands their 14-day right to cancel ends once delivery begins. Without it a credit order is refused and nothing is charged. A card order collects this on the Stripe page.

name: inkflow_order
